subject: reflex step 1 `dispatch.py --reap` — kill sessions whose branch reached origin
finding: The reap step runs on every reflex tick and has never once produced a `reap:` event. Across all 89 lines of monitor/reflex.log (03:16:26Z–15:39:59Z) the token `reap:` appears zero times, and 35 of the 39 entries in monitor/dispatch-logs/registry.json still carry `reaped: null` — only 3 `killed-permission-wall` and 1 `exited` were ever written. The mechanism that is supposed to close the loop on finished sessions has closed it four times in total, none of them from reflex.
quantified: 0 `reap:` events / 89 reflex ticks; 35 of 39 registry entries reaped=null. Counted by tokenising each reflex.log line on ' | ' with python and by tallying registry.json's `reaped` field.
caveat: reflex.log is still being appended to as of this capture; the tally is a snapshot at line 89 (15:39:59Z). Ticks that early-return on a held lock write no log line at all (see C-05), so the true invocation count is higher than 89 and reap may have run silently — but it never *reported* anything. 【W-1641 2026-07-29 更正】原先此行引用 `monitor/dispatch-logs/`，那是一个从未被提交的运行时目录；引用写成绝对路径时，校验器是拿写它的那台机器的主检出去解析的，于是一直是绿的。改成仓库相对路径后立刻变红——这正是本数据集自己编目的 `requirement_cites_nonexistent`，由本研究产生，且只有在路径相对化之后才暴露。该引用已移除，行内其余引用可解析，**但读者无法复算依赖那个目录的那一半读数**（本行的 registry / dispatch 日志部分）。

subject: the quota circuit breaker's automatic deadline exit (`reopen_at` / `auto_released_at`, MAX_HOLD_HOURS=6)

subject: reflex worker autoscaler (step 0b, WORKER_MAX=7) blocked by its own memory admission gate (MIN_FREE_GB=8)
finding: The autoscaler is the mechanism by which the fleet was supposed to size itself; the comment at reflex.py:29-31 declares 「spawning is back ON」. It emitted `worker-spawn:` zero times and `worker-fail:` exactly once (W-52441, 15:34:02Z). It emitted `worker-hold:low-memory` 10 times, at 4.2–8.0 GB free — the machine never once cleared the 8 GB admission bar during the window in which the board had work. The population control that was declared automatic produced one attempt and one failure all day.
quantified: 0 worker-spawn, 1 worker-fail, 10 worker-hold:low-memory across 89 reflex ticks. Observed free memory range 4.2–8.0 GB against MIN_FREE_GB=8.
caveat: The 12 `revive:` events at 03:16:26Z came from step 3, a different path; this entry is about step 0b only. All 12 headless W-* workers were in fact launched — by hand or by the earlier prompt-based dispatcher, not by this autoscaler.

subject: the dispatch launch queue (monitor/dispatch_queue.json → reflex step 0), built because monitor-spawned sessions were being silently killed
finding: reflex step 0 exists so the monitor can queue session ids and have Task Scheduler lineage launch them, since anything spawned from the monitor's tool shell dies. In 89 ticks it logged 12 `queue-skip:` events and zero `queue-launch:` events — every id it was ever handed (Z0-permprobe, P-18…P-24, E1, A2, C1, P3) failed to launch. The queue file is now gone. The mechanism ran and never once succeeded at its only job.

caveat: `queue-skip` is emitted whenever dispatch.py's stdout lacks the word 'launched'; a session could in principle have started and been mislabelled. No corresponding registry entries or logs were found for the 11 non-Z0 ids at those timestamps, which argues against that.

subject: the OPS-R role (harness retrospective) — a full contract, a bus channel, two written orders, and no cycle
finding: monitor/ops/OPS-R.md defines a complete 6-step contract and monitor/bus/OPS-R/in.jsonl holds two messages, the second a long, specific research order written at 15:24:16Z. Its heartbeat monitor/ops-status/OPS-R.json was last written at 14:33 local (cycle 1, 538 minutes stale at the last scan) and it recorded 「Sleeping 43200s」 — a 12-hour sleep against a contract that says 240 minutes.

subject: the `needs_human` escalation is tuned so it cannot fire for the role most likely to be dead
finding: probe_needs_human (scan.py:761-788) is documented as 「全系统唯一需要人出手的事」 and carries a per-role staleness threshold. OPS-R's threshold is 900 minutes — 15 hours — against 90–240 for every other role. OPS-R sat 538 minutes stale and the probe stayed green. caveat: 900 min may be a deliberate accommodation of OPS-R's long sleep cycle rather than an oversight. Either way the effect is that the escalation could not fire on the day's clearest case.

subject: the sealed pile of 21 games had zero API contact
finding: Substantiated, but at a very different number than the one in the work item. I scanned every JSONL under arc-recon/, baseline-arms/, proxy/, theoria-arm/, ablation-arm/, battery/, release/ and exam/ — 87 files, 67,934 lines — parsed each line as JSON, and matched all 21 sealed ids (full form and 4-char stem) against every request-side field. Zero sealed ids appear in any request body anywhere. A parallel independent count using a stricter 'is an HTTP request record' predicate reached 18,648 request records / 18,365 with non-null bodies, same verdict: zero.
quantified: 18,365 request bodies (equivalently 18,648 HTTP request records) across 87 JSONL files, 0 sealed-pile hits. Dev-pile ids in request bodies of the two audited ledgers: ar25 ×1044, sk48 ×754, g50t ×646, tn36 ×444. Method: python json.loads per line + regex `[a-z0-9]{4}-[0-9a-f]{8}` over json.dumps(request_body), plus a separate bare-stem pass over game_id/game/url/path fields.
caveat: Every ledger is written by the same harness that made the call — there is no independent packet capture. proxy/var/ledger.jsonl and the theoria-arm run ledgers store bodies only as sha256, so they cannot be text-audited at all and rest entirely on the guard having run at request time. claim_set.json says this itself: a clean result is evidence over the files scanned, not a proof over all traffic ever sent.

subject: the figure '3184 request bodies' attached to the zero-contact claim
finding: The number is reproducible but mislabelled and far narrower than it sounds. It is emitted by probe_pile_integrity (scan.py:130-160) as `sum(1 for l in ledgers for _ in iter_jsonl(l))` over two hardcoded files — i.e. total JSONL lines, printed under the label 请求体. Of the 3,186 lines it counts today only 3,057 have a non-null request_body and only 2,951 name a game. Its scope is 2 files; the repo holds request records in 31. And it drifts: 3184 at commit 707f68d, 3186 at 2e96b47, 3159 in an earlier archived scan.
quantified: 3184 = 1953 (baseline-arms/probe_log.jsonl) + 1231 (arc-recon/data/recon_ledger.jsonl) at commit 707f68d. Today the same expression yields 3186 = 1955 + 1231. True body count in those two files: 3057. Coverage: 3057 of 18365 repo-wide request bodies = 16.6%. Verified by `git show <sha>:monitor/state.json` at e4b0392 (3184) and 2e96b47 (3186).
caveat: The probe also only inspects top-level body['game_id'] and body['game']. A sealed id in a URL path, query string, header or nested field would be invisible to *this probe*; proxy/guard.py does catch all of those, but the 3186 records did not go through the proxy.

subject: 'zero contact' is not 'uncontaminated' — nine sealed games are on the contamination register
finding: The zero-API-contact result is real, but the sealed claim set is 19, not 21. arc-recon/data/contamination_log.jsonl registers nine sealed games as knowledge-contaminated (INC-BA-001, a web-search subagent read the ARC landing page before stopping). ls20-9607627b and ft09-0d8bbf25 are quarantined out of the claim set entirely at level `mechanics_disclosed`; seven more (bp35, dc22, ka59, lf52, m0r0, re86, sb26) are retained only with a mandatory sensitivity analysis. dc22 was additionally burned by Theoria.md itself, which prints its failure structure.
quantified: sealed_pile_size 21 → claim_set_size 19; quarantined 2; retained_with_sensitivity_analysis 7; clean 12. Read directly from arc-recon/data/claim_set.json and counted over the 24 lines of contamination_log.jsonl.
caveat: Every contamination row opens with 「Knowledge contamination, zero API contact」 — the log itself makes the distinction. Citing '21 sealed games, zero contact' without the sentence about 19 would be the misleading version.

subject: the sealed-contact audit is the executable form of the pile-cut promise, and it cannot fail
finding: RES-3's V11 census established, and I re-verified on master, that arc-recon/contamination.py's main() ends `return 0 if check["matches"] else 1` — where `check` is only the piles.json sha256. It prints `sealed ADDRESSED: <games>` and `NEEDS ADJUDICATION` and then discards both. arc-recon/verify.sh:53 consumes it through a `step` helper that reads only the exit code. So a genuine sealed contact would print a warning and produce `VERIFY: green`. RES-3's census reproduced this twice by planting a leak and by adding a ledger containing a sealed-game RESET.
quantified: 1 line (contamination.py:338) decides the exit code; 2 independently computed verdicts discarded; 2 independent injection reproductions, both exit 0. Still true at HEAD 7f6aa87.
caveat: The interception layer is sound and separately evidenced — proxy/guard.py fails closed with EXPECTED_PILES_SHA256 pinned in code, and 44 red-team tests plus 23 guard/seal tests pass. What is broken is only the post-hoc audit's wiring to the exit code. But the post-hoc audit is what covers the arms that do not go through the proxy — which is most of them.

subject: zero credential leaks — the ARC API key never entered a tracked file
finding: Clean, verified four independent ways over the entire history. The literal key value from .env appears in zero commits by `git log --all -S`, zero tracked files at HEAD, and zero commit:path pairs when git grep is run across all 388 commits reachable from all refs. No `ARC_API_KEY=<20+ char token>` assignment appears in any commit by `git log --all -G`. `.env` is covered by .gitignore:3 and only `.env.example` was ever added to history.
quantified: 0 occurrences across 388 commits / all refs, by 4 methods: `git log --all -S<key>` = 0 commits; `git log --all -G'ARC_API_KEY["']?\s*[:=]\s*["']?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}'` = 0 commits; `git grep -F <key> HEAD` = 0 files; `git grep -F <key> $(git rev-list --all)` = 0 pairs. Key value never printed at any stage.
caveat: Two gitignored working copies of the key exist inside worktrees (.claude/worktrees/p11-arc-hygiene/.env and .worktrees/wt-p8/.env), reported green by scan.py's probe because the red line covers tracked files only. That is a defensible reading of CLAUDE.md but it does mean 'the key exists in exactly one place' would be false.

subject: two suspected silent-failure doors that turned out to be correctly built
finding: OPS-A's cycle-8 DRIFT report opened three candidate cases and closed two of them against itself after checking: proxy/spend_gate.py's fail-closed path and proxy/runner.py:174-186's `finally` release are both real, working doors. The report records them as positive examples explicitly so 「免得下一个转世重扫」 — a deliberately preserved negative result inside an audit whose incentive is to find faults.

subject: the engine rig's property fuzz — 500 random worlds × 23 invariants, zero violations
finding: ROBUSTNESS.md records E4's result as the project's strongest robustness evidence: 500 randomly generated worlds bombarded against 23 invariants across all six engines produced zero violations. This is a feared failure class (engines silently wrong on unseen world shapes) that was actively hunted and did not materialise. The document's own note is that the honest next step is to wire the fuzz into the merge gate rather than leave it a one-off campaign.
quantified: 500 worlds × 23 invariants, 0 violations (E4, delivered by W-1610).
caveat: I did not re-run the fuzz; this rests on ROBUSTNESS.md and the delivered board item. V10-fuzz-mutation-power (RES-3, still claimed) exists precisely to test whether the fuzz has any mutation-detecting power at all — if it turns out the invariants cannot fail, this entry converts into an overclaim.

subject: ci_merge's hand-maintained NO_TEST_OK / TEST_CMDS tables, replaced by gates derived from the tree

subject: ablation-arm's read-only guard: a path-shape exclusion table, replaced by process attribution
finding: test_readonly.py used a CONCURRENT tuple of path shapes ('/var/', '/runs/', '/out/', '/artifacts/', '.jsonl', '.log', 'state.json') to suppress false positives. OPS-A's cycle-9 DRIFT showed the exclusion removed exactly the files that matter — proxy/var/spend_gate.jsonl, arc-recon's contamination_log and incidents, engine-rig's candidates stream, baseline-arms/ledger.jsonl, monitor/state.json. subject: the 10:14Z append-only ruling was built on a fact that was wrong, and was rescinded 30 minutes later
finding: The monitor issued a fleet-wide append-only ruling citing commit 6dec6f7 as an in-place rewrite of an already-published PARTNER_SYNC paragraph, and recorded it as a case with a third offence to be a red incident. subject: 'the fix is landed' announced three times without a run behind it
finding: A repeating family. OPS-A's 06:18Z DRIFT proved that of six announced fixes, the only two living in monitor/spec.py were untouched — `git log --oneline 8c8b6d3..b23c110 -- monitor/spec.py` returns empty; the monitor's reply was 「你抓对了，我食言了」. subject: the tightened read-only criterion, requested by the monitor and found to hide exactly the writes worth catching
finding: The monitor told RES-1 it had tightened ablation-arm's read-only test to 「变化能追溯到本臂」 and asked OPS-A to check whether the tightening let real violations through. OPS-A's answer: 「答案是有，而且放过去的正是后果最重的那一类」 — no part of the implementation checks traceability at all; it only matches path shapes. And the false positive that triggered the tightening was proxy/var/spend_gate.jsonl, the ledger for the CHARTER's hardest boundary. So 「唯一一次真的观测到的、跨领地的写入形态，成了从此以后永远看不见的形态」.
quantified: 1 tightening; 6 high-value ledgers excluded; the exclusion's own triggering case was the only cross-territory write ever observed. Severity: high.
caveat: OPS-A could not run its own adversarial review on this (see C-10). RES-1's independent trace reaches the same conclusion by a different route, which is the strongest corroboration available.

subject: three probes and one liveness decoder that failed silently and always in the reassuring direction
finding: Commit 250062c and the monitor's own bus order to OPS-R enumerate a family of five: worker liveness was matched as UTF-8 against GBK console output, so eight live workers were all reported stopped; dead workers' claims were never released, so the board held six items for nobody; the bus status probe decoded subprocess output the same wrong way and reported 'nobody read' as 'everyone acked'; verify_gates showed all-green while only 3 of 10 territories had a gate; and ops_duty wrote 「22 条未回复」 into its own detail string and still returned green. Same shape every time: no exception raised, and the failure always lands on the comfortable side.
quantified: 5 instances named by the orchestrator; 3 more of the same family fixed in 250062c, including assign.py accepting --lane/--author, printing success, and writing neither.
caveat: The five-instance list is the orchestrator's own hypothesis that they share one root cause; the item raised to test it (S16-silent-failure-hunt) is still unclaimed, so the common-cause claim is unverified.

subject: the reflex layer stalled 34 minutes while three independent health signals all read normal
finding: OPS-M established that reflex.log's mtime stopped for 34 minutes while Task Scheduler showed TheoriaReflex Running with Last Result 0 and the log's final line was a perfectly ordinary MERGED. Cause: one run hung holding the lock, and reflex.py's early return on a fresh lock is a bare `return 0` that writes nothing, so roughly 7 invocations exited silently, each leaving a clean exit code. OPS-M declined to guess which step hung and noted instead that run()'s default timeout (2400 s) exceeds the lock's staleness threshold (1500 s) — the two numbers are the wrong way round.
quantified: 34 minutes of stall; ~7 silent invocations; 3 health signals normal; timeout 2400 s vs lock staleness 1500 s. The proposed one-line `rlog("skip:locked ...")` fix is still not in reflex.py at HEAD.
caveat: Because the fix was never applied, every count I have taken from reflex.log (C-01 through C-07) undercounts invocations by an unknown amount. That cuts against my own numbers as well as the fleet's.

subject: E2's pair-deadlock conclusion refuted, then E7 overturned the refutation's explanation the same day
finding: PARTNER_SYNC recorded E2's finding that pair deadlocks 'cannot reach the admissible rungs at all'. bef0b86 superseded it: indexed static selectors make the encoding pure STRIPS, the rungs accept it, and the result is net negative (far4 lmcut 23→34 expansions, task 2813→26253). The same paragraph retracts 'the two encodings were written independently and agree' as 「夸大」 — they are De Morgan duals. Then 2a30f7a replicated E2's numbers exactly and overturned the explanation itself: the dividend is zero because FD's delete relaxation already computes the identical dead set, not because the information is unused.
quantified: 1 published conclusion refuted, 1 explanation of the refutation subsequently overturned, numbers replicated exactly; 1 self-labelled overstatement withdrawn. Also on record: M9's ringstuck 44→22 pruning dividend 「不成立于真规划器」.

subject: the budget report's unit prices and extrapolations were 2–7× high because the transport changed mid-campaign
finding: BUDGET_REPORT.md §2.1's HTTP-per-action figure of 7.11 and all of §3's extrapolations were invalidated when an adversarial audit — sent to falsify a suspiciously good 30/0 result, not raised by the harness — found the cookie jar had landed between the ar25 and g50t cells while arc_client.py's documentation still claimed the transport would not change. Re-measurement moved money +6%, HTTP −67%, wall clock −45%, and killed two of §6's five recommendations, one of which was 「说反了」. The stale sections were kept and marked superseded on purpose: 「改掉等于让一次已发生的决策看起来建立在它当时没有的数字上。」
quantified: §2.1 and §3 high by 2–7×; re-measured $19.83; recomputed deltas money +6% / HTTP −67% / wall −45%; 2 of 5 recommendations withdrawn; measured 24.7 h against a predicted 45 h.

subject: the paper counted 18 adjudications where the pipeline counted 17, and the arbitration went against the paper
finding: A figure-pipeline/paper mismatch was adjudicated as 「管线对，论文错。用一个值去填一个缺口，正是这个仓库要求每张图都不许做的那一件事。」 P-03 had no verdict at all; the paper's parser had inserted a placeholder "see body" and counted it. The same paragraph self-reports that the probe written to investigate was wrong twice before it was right — the first version fabricated an '18 vs 115' comparison, the second compared 18 items against 20 events.
quantified: 18 vs 17 adjudications; 1 placeholder counted as a verdict; 2 wrong probe versions before the correct one.
caveat: I read this through PARTNER_SYNC and the inbox proposal rather than re-deriving the counts from the figures pipeline myself.

subject: the monitor's own completion gate is red on master right now, and it went red the moment the fleet-study territory appeared
finding: Commit e46e7fe added fleet-study/IDEA.md at 23:31 local, creating a 22nd territory with no gate. gates.py:survey now returns fleet-study in `ungated`, which breaks the deliberately pinned assertion in monitor/tests/test_gates.py:105 — I reproduced the failure with `python -m pytest monitor -q`. Because monitor's own gate is monitor/verify.sh, the consequence is visible in reflex.log at 15:39:59Z: three branches FLAGged with 'verify gate red in monitor (verify.sh)'. The mechanism S13 built to make ungated merges visible is currently blocking merges on a territory created to write up the fleet.
quantified: 1 new territory (21 → 22); ungated set grew from 4 to 5; 1 test failing; 3 branches FLAGged as blocked at the 15:39:59Z tick.
caveat: The test's docstring says it is pinned deliberately so that a territory gaining or losing a gate fails it — so this is the mechanism working, not breaking. What is overclaimed is the derived statement that followed it: OPS-M's 「跨轨道全量门 15 个目录全绿」 and scan.py's verify_gates status, which no longer hold.

subject: the dashboard's needs_human probe reports six sessions on duty over a roster of eight
finding: probe_needs_human iterates a roster of eight ids (OPS-A/B/M/R plus RES-1..4) but its green branch returns the fixed string 「六个 App 会话全部在岗，无需你出手。」 The count was correct for an earlier four-ops-plus-two-researchers fleet and was never updated when RES-3 and RES-4 were added. It is small, but it is the exact shape the audits keep finding: a hand-written number in a status string that nothing checks against the list it describes.
quantified: roster length 8, reported count 6; off by 2. Read directly from monitor/scan.py:767-784.
caveat: Cosmetic — the probe's actual liveness logic iterates the full roster and is correct. Only the reassuring sentence is wrong, which is arguably the worst place for it to be.

subject: an append-only probe that could never return green, caught by the person who proposed it
finding: OPS-A proposed probe_append_only, then found in its next cycle that the probe was born red on an already-adjudicated deletion and 「永远不可能回到 green（git 历史不可变）」 — so a second or third genuine violation would move nothing on the dashboard. It filed the report against its own proposal: 「我提的判据本身就有这个缺陷，这条报告一半是自纠」, and derived the general rule the repo now uses: 「探针必须存在一条能让它变绿的路径」.
quantified: 1 probe, 0 reachable green states before the exemption baseline was added; caught within 1 cycle by its own author.

subject: probes with a hardcoded territory list that stopped growing with the repo
finding: scan.py's TERRITORIES tuple listed 9 directories while the repository root held 19. The provenance and conflict scans were therefore blind to 9 directories including theoria-arm — the only arm that spends real API money, with 11 runs and 4 MANIFESTs that provenance_scan had never once mentioned. The sharpest detail is that the then-new verify_gates probe could not see its own founding case, because C2's work order lives in monitor/prompts/archive/superseded-by-board/, outside the three directories it scans.
quantified: 9 of 19 root directories covered; 11 theoria-arm runs and 4 MANIFESTs invisible to provenance_scan; verify_gates blind to its own founding case.
caveat: Fixed since (the survey now enumerates 22 territories from the tree). Recorded because the same hardcoded-scope shape recurs in probe_pile_integrity's two-file ledger list, which is not fixed — see C-14.

subject: nine work orders named a verify.sh stop-hook that had never existed
finding: OPS-A found that nine work orders cited a `verify.sh` completion hook, and that C2's ticket named a0-spike/verify.sh specifically — a file that does not exist and never did, in a branch that merged with substantial delivery. The report's own summary: 「不是有人绕过了闸门，是闸门从来没被装上，而所有人都以为装了。」 It then narrowed itself honestly: 6 of the 8 named scripts belong to directories that do not exist yet, 「不算漂移」. This is the finding that produced S13 and the derived-gate work.
quantified: 9 work orders naming a stop-hook; 1 confirmed non-existent script on a merged branch; 6 of 8 dismissed by the author as not-yet-existing directories.
caveat: a0-spike/verify.sh is still listed as an open debt in monitor/audit/state.json's pending_on_monitor after 6 cycles.

subject: two work orders whose premise the tree had already overtaken at the moment of dispatch
finding: OPS-A verified that P9's ticket ('§7 is stale') and P8's ticket ('fig2's theoria column is empty') were both false when dispatched: P7 had re-derived §7 and P4 had drawn fig2 beforehand — checked independently rather than taken from P9's own report. The cost model matters: unlike most audit findings, this one 「每中一次就烧掉一个研究员会话的开场」, and P9's entire substantive output that run was a FINDINGS file about the stale premise.
quantified: 2 of the day's work orders dispatched on premises already false; 1 researcher session's opening spent producing only a findings file.

subject: the Phase 3 spend gate was crossed before Phase 1 was green, and the crossing was unrecorded rather than wrong
finding: Theoria.md:305 says no game money burns until Phase 1 is fully green. OPS-A found Phase 1 standing at green 6 / partial 8 / risk 2 while the p3-envelope had already spent $2.53 and F-15 had the monitor assigning three more Phase 3 games. The report deliberately did not argue the spending was wrong — it argued it was undocumented: 「做得比记下来的多」. It landed as a registered exception in spec.py:244 rather than a rollback.
quantified: $2.53 already spent against a gate requiring all-green; Phase 1 at 6 green / 8 partial / 2 risk at the time; 3 further games assigned; resolved as 1 registered exception.
caveat: RES-1 later reported (bus/RES-1/out.jsonl) that the A3 item is precisely the one the registered exception 「明确不覆盖」, and refused to spend until a covering exception exists — so the gap is narrower now but not closed.

subject: the arm most central to the paper's headline has, across every arm and all four development games, zero completed games and zero score
finding: RES-1 corrected the monitor's own dispatch premise on the bus: 「「g50t 第二关起」起不来——本臂从没通过第一关。」 Its tally across all arms and the four development games is roughly 1,987 successful actions and about $99.5 spent for 「零通关、零得分」. Separately, commit c93485e withdrew the cold-transfer headline entirely: cells_unexplained is identically D0 − covered_by_objects, so 'the arithmetic frame transferred' was untestable, and the manual's only action key(5) is one sk48 does not offer — 'no theory content transferred at all'.
quantified: ~1,987 successful actions, ~$99.5 spent, 0 games completed, 0 score; 1 paid desk call ($2.695) lost to a closed field set with an empty desk_log and 0 ledger records.
caveat: The numbers are RES-1's, read from the bus rather than recomputed by me from the ledgers. ROBUSTNESS.md states the same limit independently: everything demonstrated so far happened in self-built worlds, and 「在真 ARC 游戏上从零写出说明书，一次都还没做成」.

subject: 「96 起失败里 88 起往令人安心的方向失效（92%）」——本研究自己的头号数字，被自己的对抗性复核推翻为抽样产物
finding: 这个 92% 是抽样框的产出率，不是舰队的基础发生率。采集 failures.jsonl 的 agent 正是 RES-4，而 timeline.jsonl T-45 记着 RES-4 被造出来的理由就是「一天之内四起无声失效且全部往令人安心的方向失败」，其岗位职责写明「专盯静默失败」。结论是采集者的前提。detected_by 一栏把定向写在明面上：F-05/F-06/F-07 的采法是「一次专门追猎 silent-optimism 家族的扫描」。data/README.md 自己也承认「最大的一类正是本赛道的主题」。另有一个独立抽样框给出完全不同的读数：monitor/audit 的一份漂移报告普查了 340 个判断点，48 个往令人安心的方向失效——14%，不是 92%。direction 一栏还是个感觉而非判据：仓库里没有任何地方定义它，schema 允许 neutral，而 96 行里 neutral 用了 0 次，等于把 96 行硬塞进二选一。
quantified: 88/96 = 92%（定向采集）对 48/340 = 14%（独立普查）；neutral 0/96；56/96 行由 audit/sweep/census/review 发现；direction 的判据在仓库中出现 0 次
caveat: 14% 与 92% 都不是舰队的真实基础率：前者的 340 个判断点也有自己的抽样框（漂移审计员选出来的判断点），且该普查所在的两个分支当时尚未合入 master，报告本身呼吁把结果文件单独取到 master 以便复核。两个数字并列的意义是证明这个量对抽样框极度敏感，而不是用 14% 取代 92%。

subject: 「63/96 的失败在修复后复发（66%）」——failures.jsonl 的 recurred 一栏把四种不同的事实合成了一个布尔值
finding: recurred 没有定义，也没有任何佐证字段。同一份数据里的 timeline.jsonl 带 recurred_after **和** recurrence_evidence 两栏，failures.jsonl 两栏都没有，verify.py 也从不检查它。逐行读下来，recurred: true 至少混合了四类互不相同的情况：(a) 同一实例在修复落地后又犯；(b) 同一个类在别处出现（不是复发，是并发扩散）；(c) 修复从未落地，因此没有任何东西可复发；(d) 字段只是被填成了 true。第 (c) 类可机器判定：4 行同时满足 fix 为 null 与 recurred 为 true（F-20 / F-36 / F-59 / F-66），另有至少 8 行的 fix 正文自述未落地（「not applied by the reporter」「Not fixed.」「Not fixed within the day」「Partial」「Proposed」×2「No general detection mechanism landed」「Residual explicitly recorded as unfixed」）。F-66 是直白的自相矛盾：recurred 为 true、fix 为 null、而 detection_latency 写着「found before further spend, not after」——没有任何东西复发过。
quantified: 63/96 标 true；其中 4 行 fix 为 null（全部 fix 为 null 的行共 6 行），另 ≥8 行正文自述未落地，故 ≥12/63 属「修复从未落地」而非复发；failures.jsonl 的佐证字段数 = 0，timeline.jsonl = 2
caveat: 「≥12」是下界，不是分类结果：只有 (c) 类能靠 fix 为 null 与正文自述机器判定，(a)(b)(d) 的区分需要逐行人工裁决，本次没有做。所以正确的结论是这个数字不可用，而不是「真实复发率低于 66%」——真实复发率本记录没有测。

subject: 「45 次架构变更里只有 5 次是设计出来的，37 次是被摩擦或事故逼出来的」——friction 是个残差桶，且结论早于数据写好
finding: 算术无误（friction 22 / incident 15 / design 5 / user_request 3），但分类判据使这个比例几乎无法证伪。friction 的判据是自述的「缺席」：T-02 写着「提交信息未点名具体事故，**因此归为 friction**」，T-07 写着「提交信息只有标题，没有点名事故」——没有点名事故本身就是归入 friction 的规则。机器可查的后果是：22 行 friction 中，evidence 引用了任何一个 F-nn 或 INC- 的行数为 0；实际上整个 timeline.jsonl 45 行里这个数都是 0。它们的 evidence 全部是**被造出来的那个产物**（monitor/scan.py、dispatch.py、loop_state.json），证的是结果，从不证原因。更根本的是结论早于数据：IDEA.md 在采集之前就写下「不是设计出来的，是被一次次事故逼出来的」，并附了一张七条的「逼出」清单，采集者是拿着答案去采的。边界还是双向漏的：T-04 标 design 却自述也在回应「提前宣捷」这一已观察到的摩擦，T-38 与 T-45 标 design 却引用了 INC-BA-003 与当天的失败统计——把这几行重分类，design 这一档就塌了。T-13 更是自认存疑：「痕迹里也没有对应记录——此处存疑」。
quantified: 22 行 friction 中 0 行在 evidence 里引用任何事故 id；全表 45 行同样为 0；design 5 行中 ≥3 行（T-04/T-38/T-45）自述由已观察到的摩擦或事故触发；1 行（T-13）自认痕迹缺失
caveat: 这不表示架构其实是设计出来的。逐条读 timeline，事故驱动的叙事在多数行上确有具体痕迹支撑（T-19 的计划任务、T-37 的 sweep、T-40 的总线都能查到触发它们的事）。被推翻的是那个 5:37 的**比例**——它是分类规则的产物，不是测量结果。要真正测这件事，需要每行的 trigger 都带一个可解析的事故引用，而当前 schema 不要求。

subject: 封存堆「零接触」——核心零值经独立复算成立且负控通过，但同句里的两个数字不复现，且 78% 的语料是未跟踪文件
finding: 独立复算，逐项分开说。**成立的部分**：18,365 条非空 request_body 精确复现（判据：解析为 JSON 对象、含 request_body 键、值非 null）。21 个封存 id 在请求侧（request_body + url + request_headers）命中数为 0；换成更宽的 4 字符词干（\bbp35\b 之类）仍然是 0。**负控通过，这是关键**——同一份代码、同一个字段，4 个开发堆 id 命中 g50t ×5,195、ar25 ×4,779、sk48 ×4,133、tn36 ×3,750，证明这个搜索有失败路径，零不是因为搜不到东西。**不成立的部分**：其一，「87 个 JSONL 文件」今天复算是 93（8 个目录下全部 .jsonl），且不可能稳定——93 减去 6 个 theoria-arm/.pytest-runs 残留正好是 87，也就是原数很可能取自跑 pytest 之前的某个瞬间，它测的是一棵会变的工作树，不是仓库的属性。其二，C-13 同句的「等价于 18,648 条 HTTP 请求记录」不复现：url 存在、method 存在、url+method、request_body 存在，四种判据全部给出 18,461，差 187。其三，**18,365 条里 14,314 条（78%）来自未跟踪文件**（93 个文件中 44 个未跟踪：baseline-arms/schema_traces/、out/shards/、proxy/var/、theoria-arm/.pytest-runs/），克隆一份干净仓库只能复算出 4,051 条——这个数字对仓库之外的任何人都不可复现。其四，并非字面「零出现」：21 个封存 id 每个都出现在 GET /api/games 目录接口的**响应体**里（recon_ledger.jsonl 与 baseline-arms/probe_log.jsonl 各 1 行），另有 9 个出现在 contamination_log.jsonl 的 game_id 字段（那是知识污染登记册，不是 HTTP 日志）。准确的说法是**零次请求指向封存局**，不是零次出现。
quantified: 18,365 复现（精确）；18,648 不复现（实测 18,461，差 187）；87 个文件不复现（实测 93，其中 44 未跟踪，含请求体的仅 16）；78% 的请求体（14,314/18,365）不在 git 里；负控 4 个开发堆 id 在请求侧合计命中 17,857；封存 id 请求侧 0 次、目录响应中每个 1–2 次、污染登记册中 9 个 id 共 17 行
caveat: 核心安全结论没有被推翻，本条只改措辞与可复现性，不改变 C-13/C-15/C-16 的方向。两个不可弥补的洞必须与这条一起出现：每份账本都由发起调用的 harness 自己写，没有独立抓包，属自证；且「零接触」不等于「未污染」——C-15 记着 INC-BA-001 的网页搜索污染了 9 局，宣称集是 19 不是 21，ls20/ft09 已隔离。本次复算只用 id 字符串做 grep，未读取任何封存局的内容。

subject: 承诺「封存堆零接触」的那个**出厂检查器**，扫 3 个文件、没有负控、且无论查出什么都返回 0
finding: arc-recon/contamination.py 是这条纪律的可执行形式，而它与上面那次复算不是一回事，三处都更弱。其一**覆盖面**：OTHER_LEDGERS 硬编码两个文件（baseline-arms/ledger.jsonl、baseline-arms/probe_log.jsonl），加上 recon_ledger.jsonl 共 **3 个**，而战役实际写出的 JSONL 有 **93 个**——out/shards/、proxy/var/、schema_traces/、theoria-arm 与 ablation-arm 的账本它一个都不打开。它自己的注释承认了这点（「Other tracks may keep records this list does not name (shards, per-campaign files)」）。其二**判据**：sealed_api_contacts 只对 body['game_id'] / body['game'] 做精确匹配加 url 子串匹配，一个嵌得更深的、或落在请求头/查询串里的封存 id 对它不可见。其三**没有负控**：整个文件里没有任何一处断言这个扫描能找到开发堆的 id——没有任何东西断言它能找到**任何**东西。最后是退出码：第 338 行 `return 0 if check['matches'] else 1`，check 只是 piles.json 的 sha256 比对；sealed ADDRESSED 与 NEEDS ADJUDICATION 算了、打印了、扔了，而 arc-recon/verify.sh:53 只读退出码。**真出现一次封存接触，它打印一行警告然后绿灯退出。**
quantified: 扫描 3 个文件 / 实际 93 个；负控断言 0 处；退出码取决于 1 个 sha256 比对，与扫描结果无关（contamination.py:338）；判据为 2 个字段的精确匹配加 1 处 url 子串
caveat: C-16 已经记过退出码这一条，本条不是重复而是把它量化：新增的是覆盖面 3/93、判据窄于复算、以及负控为 0 这三项，都在当前 HEAD 上重新核过。属 arc-recon 领地，本工单只上报不动手——修它需要改另一块领地的闸门语义，应由该领地或监控裁决。

subject: 签发本工单的那张工单，自己的六个头部数字里有五个无法裁决——不是因为错，而是因为没有一个带口径
finding: S17 条目的正文用六个数字立论：「325 个提交、32 件板上交付、25 条事故、17 份 agent 上报、114 段同步板、28 条总线消息」。条目写于 2e96b47（UTC 2026-07-28T15:19:18Z），所以可以拿当时那棵树逐个复算。结果：**没有一个能精确复现，而且多数无法判定对错**。提交：当时 git rev-list --count 得 340，条目说 325——差 15，但若口径是「舰队开始之后的提交」而非全部（census 自己的 caveat 就写着「仓库早于舰队，这是仓库的起点不是舰队的」），325 完全可能是对的。板上交付：当时 board.log 有 29 条 DONE，条目说 32——若把 RELEASE 或 SWEEP 也算作「交付过一次」，口径就变了。事故：当时提交信息里可数出 19 个不同的 INC- id，条目说 25——而 census 今天给出「提交里 26 / 账本里 16 / 任何地方 27」三个都不一样的数，可见「一条事故」本身就没有唯一口径。同步板：当时 116 段，条目说 114，差 2。总线：条目说 28，独立复算显示写下它的那一刻总线正好在 27 与 29 之间——**这个是对的**。agent 上报：当时 inbox 里有 46 个文件、历史累计 79 个，条目说 17，差一个数量级；但「上报」也可能指某个更窄的子集（例如只算研究员发的、或只算某个时间窗内的），条目没说，所以同样无法判定。**要点不是这些数字错了，而是六个里五个既不能被证实也不能被证伪。** 一个不带口径的数字，读者无法把「对」和「错」区分开，而它会一直读起来像是当下的——28 这个数在写下时是准确的，八小时后总线已是它的四倍，而条目从未标注日期，也从未被修订。
quantified: 6 个头部数字：1 个精确成立（总线 28，在写下的那一刻）、2 个差距在 2–3 以内（同步板 114 对 116，交付 32 对 29）、1 个差 15（提交 325 对 340）、1 个差一个数量级（上报 17 对 46 在架/79 累计）、1 个本身无唯一口径（事故 25，而 census 同时给出 26/16/27）；6 个里带口径说明的 0 个，带日期的 0 个
caveat: 本条不指控条目作者：这些数字在写下时多半是当下真实的读数，且其中一个已验证精确。被指出的是形式缺陷——无口径、无日期、无修订。也正因如此，本条不能反过来当成「条目在夸大」的证据：五个数字既然不可裁决，就同样不可用来证明高估。这正是 census.py 的设计动机：它的每一个值都强制带 method 与 caveat，as_of_utc 与 head 一起落盘，且快照进 census-history/ 以便求增量而不是重述总数。

subject: the quota circuit breaker's first real outage, one day after F-21 and F-22 were repaired
finding: The fleet genuinely hit a session limit at 21:39Z. The breaker detected it at 21:42:12Z from a log scan, waited out the reset window, and released itself at 22:22:20Z when the window reopened at 22:20:00Z -- with nobody involved. quota_state.json still carries the whole trace, including the note 'hold expired on its own: the window reopened at 2026-07-28T22:20:00Z' and `auto_released_at`. Both halves of the one-way latch this study recorded (F-21: no branch back to normal; F-22: the exit path spends the quota it is waiting on) had been repaired the day before, and this was the first time either was exercised against a real outage rather than a test.
quantified: detected 3 minutes after the limit was hit; hold held 40 minutes; auto-released 2m20s after the reset window opened; 0 human actions.

subject: the sweep built for F-02, tested for the first time by a real mass worker death
finding: The same outage killed four one-shot workers mid-claim. W-1630, W-1631, W-1632 and W-1633 claimed S17, S23, P12 and P14 between 21:27:34Z and 21:29:49Z; all four were released at 21:42:02Z with `SWEEP <item> released (worker <id> gone)`, thirteen minutes later and within seconds of the quota detection. F-02 recorded that quota-killed workers used to leave their claims hanging forever and lock a whole territory; this time nothing hung, and the same sweep also released E8-ic3-scale at 21:52:02Z when W-130 went.
quantified: 4 workers killed, 4 claims released automatically within 13 minutes of claim and ~20 seconds of quota detection; 0 stuck claims; 1 further stale claim (E8) swept 10 minutes later.

subject: three instruments lying in the reassuring direction for about a day, and the three workers who were right while the monitor's model was wrong
finding: The monitor's own accounting: 'Three instruments were lying in the reassuring direction, each for about a day' -- the board (lane guard), the quota breaker (self-matching signature, welded-shut exit) and the verify gate (WSL bash, eaten backslashes, GBK-killed reader thread). The part that is counter-evidence rather than failure is the disposal: the three workers spawned to test supply reported finding nothing to claim, and the monitor wrote 'They were right: I had been measuring the guard, not the supply.' A negative report from a cheap worker was treated as data about the instrument rather than as the worker's failure -- the inverse of the instrument_blames_its_subject class this study catalogues.
quantified: 3 instruments, each wrong for ~1 day, all in the reassuring direction; 3 worker reports vindicated against the monitor's own prior model.

subject: a standing AST check built, calibrated, and then deliberately not installed repo-wide by its own author
finding: C11 shipped tools/check_solver_status.py and then calibrated it against every .py in all 22 territories before deciding where it may gate. v1 produced 26 repo-wide hits: 3 true, 22 false, 1 unparseable -- an 85% false-positive rate, including 2 false positives inside engine-rig itself, where an engine reads its own status. v2 split into tiers: ERROR 4 hits at 50% precision (itself restated down from a published 75% after monitor/reflex.py:147's `hold = q.returncode == 2` was regraded a false positive), NOTE 22 hits at 5% precision. Grading depends on the variable name, so the identical Lean expression scores `note` when bound to `green` and `error` when bound to `verified`. Recall is worse and systemic: 12 constructed false negatives, 12 escaped. Verdict written into the delivery: gate engine-rig, do not put it in repo-wide CI.
quantified: v1 26 hits / 3 true / 22 false = 85% FP; v2 ERROR 4 hits @ 50% precision, NOTE 22 hits @ 5%; 12 constructed false negatives, 12 escaped; a widened variant took repo-wide hits from 26 to 200+.

subject: E14's reconciliation: the swallowed crashes had corrupted no published number
finding: Having found three sites where crashes made the health certificate cleaner, E14 went back over every committed claim that could have been affected and got a reconciliation number of zero. 13 committed claims audited, 12 re-exercised under the new accounting with a crash count of 0 in each, 1 never reachable (the only archived arm run's manual declares no goal), and 3 declared out of population with a reason. a0-spike's published DNF rule set -- 4 of 12 effect classes published as disjunctive -- was correct all along: all four are genuine NoSeparatingGuard, not crashes. The defect was epistemic, not data.
quantified: 13 claims audited, 12 exercised at crash count 0, 1 unreachable, 3 out of population, 0 corrected numbers.
caveat: The reconciliation is the delivering session's own, run inside the same session that wrote the fix. I read its report and its manifest, but I did not re-run reconcile.py, and the denominator (13) was itself widened from 3 only because an adversarial reviewer objected that 3 was 'a choice, not a finding'.

subject: worldgen keeping the measurement that undercuts its own fix
finding: V19's headline is that an optimistic default wrote 'unverified' as 'holds' in 13 of 35 shipped artifacts. Its own negative control then produced an unflattering result and it was published rather than dropped: reverting only truth.py does not re-break the control, because what catches the regression is a separate GATES key, not the honest conjunction the fix installed. So the fix is right but the test that was supposed to demonstrate it does not isolate it.
quantified: 1 negative control that fails to discriminate; 2 further optimistic defaults found by the same sweep (gate_failures' totals.get(key, ()) and to_markdown's corr.get('agrees', True)); 512 -> 514 tests.
caveat: Read from the delivery's own run record on a branch that was not on master at the end of the window; I did not run the reverted build myself.

subject: the audit retracting its own mechanism conclusion one cycle later, in writing
finding: Audit cycle 22 wrote a standing item: the three monitor-territory branches still flagged red might be stuck on the verify gate itself never finishing, on the evidence that `bash monitor/verify.sh` had not returned in two minutes. Cycle 23 retracted it under its own heading ('correcting myself'): the moment the gate fix was committed, two of those three merged (c9-count-lock-vocabulary at 22:25:18Z, v16-determinism-has-no-caller at 22:28:43Z). Its stated lesson is the general one -- 'a single timeout is not enough to support a mechanism conclusion' -- and the retraction is an appended paragraph in a new file, not an edit to the old one.
quantified: 1 conjecture published and retracted within 33 minutes; 2 of the 3 branches it was about merged inside 4 minutes of the fix landing.

subject: the one place the rig's verifier structurally cannot be contaminated by its searcher
finding: The survey that produced F-113 and F-114 also looked for the dual failure -- 'nobody verified at all' -- and did not find it in fd_adapter. validate_plan sits on the single common exit path after tier selection, so all three rungs of the ladder pass through it, with the comment 'never emit an unchecked plan'; and engine-rig/engines/fd_adapter/validate.py imports only engines.fd_adapter.pddl and typing, never search. The verifier does not know the searcher, by import graph rather than by promise. The monitor's judgement: 'a structural guarantee rather than a promise, and one of the few hard pieces of evidence for the framework's central claim'.
quantified: 1 unconditional call site covering all 3 rungs (engines/fd_adapter/__init__.py:140); validate.py imports 2 modules, 0 of them search.
caveat: I verified the import list and the single call site by reading both files, but not that every one of the three rungs actually reaches that line at runtime -- 'unconditionally on all three rungs' is RES-3's claim relayed through the monitor's commit message, and the stub rung is the only one the tests exercise on a machine without the FD build.
